entry.title: From cost center to growth engine: The supply chain value shift
entry.summary: The resilience era is over. Learn how leading companies are converting supply chain investments into margin, market share and growth.

entry.title: FedEx launches China-US air capacity ahead of peak season
entry.summary: Weekly routes will connect manufacturing hubs in Shanghai and Guangzhou to U.S. destinations to support artificial intelligence-driven demand.

entry.title: Conagra Brands to close Missouri ingredients plant
entry.summary: Production at the facility, which employs 442 workers, will primarily be transferred to locations in Arkansas.

entry.title: UniUni to tap carriers like Gofo for some peak season deliveries
entry.summary: The delivery provider said handing off select packages will benefit last-mile efficiency as it looks to improve its financial outlook.

entry.title: AI-backed tools power Reformation’s inventory management
entry.summary: The apparel company is leveraging the technology to monitor demand and make informed production decisions.

entry.title: Amazon to expand fuel and logistics surcharge to more services
entry.summary: The 3.5% surcharge will apply to transportation fees for bulk storage and replenishment services starting in February as the company faces fuel cost pressures.

entry.title: Wrangler parent company plans to beef up inventory spending
entry.summary: Kontoor Brands said it will invest $50 million to recover from a bumpy Q3 for its supply chain that saw inventory fall 6% year over year.

entry.title: Fashion brand nixes dedicated fulfillment model to boost transit times
entry.summary: For Love & Lemons is now shipping orders from a Cart.com facility in Texas, helping it lower storage costs and provide speedier deliveries.

entry.title: How to prepare for the most severe El Niño on record
entry.summary: As this year's severe weather approaches, manufacturers should audit their systems for failure risks and take other protective measures, experts say.

entry.title: US Foods to test inventory-scanning robots at 6 more warehouses
entry.summary: The food service distributor plans to begin piloting the technology in each of the facilities by year-end, CEO David Flitman told investors.
